coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore, hyphen or comb run: the characters' box (first to last character). Text tick box "/ /" or "[ ]": the three characters' box. Drawn rule: its x extent and the 10 pt above it. Drawn box: its rectangle.
how_measured: pdfplumber drawn rules and characters ("o" box glyphs ink-measured at 400 dpi); page 8 measured in the picture's own 595x755 pixels (soft mask composited over white, rules light grey: threshold 230) and converted through its placement (0.6753 pt/px); every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: Subscription agreement signature page of a REIT (HTML form printed portrait, pages 5-7), a direct deposit authorization filed as a picture (page 8) and a transfer on death form (pages 9-10). The investor's own acknowledgement and signature sections (Sections 4 and 5) are NOT printed in this file: the sections jump from 3 to 6. Investor signatures appear only on the optional DRIP enrollment (page 6), the direct deposit form (page 8) and the TOD form (page 10), each with a joint owner. The custodian signs page 5 for IRAs; the registered representative and broker-dealer sign page 7. No acceptance block for the company.
